title: The Helpful Robot
content:
Tom lives in a smart house with his family. The house has many automated devices.

Every morning, a small robot helps him get ready for work.

— Can you wake me up at seven? — Tom asks.

— Of course! — the robot says.

At seven o’clock, it wakes him up and turns on the lights.

Tom goes to the kitchen.

— Can you make coffee for me?

The robot makes it and brings the coffee to him.

Tom smiles.

— Thank you!

Later, his wife calls him.

— Can you send me the shopping list?

— Sure! I'll send it now.

In the afternoon, Tom arrives home.

The robot opens the door for him.

— You are always helping us! — Tom says.

The robot smiles.

— I like helping you.

Tom looks around the smart house.

Maybe automation is making their lives a little easier.
